package.description: Install JetBrains Fleet on a remote machine for remote development

en-US.description: Install JetBrains Fleet on a remote machine for remote development
en-US.longDescription: You can install JetBrains Fleet on a remote machine for remote development. This addresses the case when you have a powerful box at home or in the office, and you want to use your local workstation as a thin client. This approach allows you to leverage higher compute capacity and avoid running heavy tasks locally.
en-US.name: Fleet Launcher (Early Access Program)

zh-CN.description: 在远程机器上安装 JetBrains Fleet 以进行远程开发
zh-CN.longDescription: 您可以在远程机器上安装 JetBrains Fleet 以进行远程开发。这解决了当您在家里或办公室里有一台功能强大的设备，并且希望将本地工作站用作瘦客户机时的情况。这种方法允许您利用更强的计算能力，避免在本地运行繁重的任务。
zh-CN.name: Fleet Launcher（抢先体验计划）
